_comment: The LindDUP data set's pipeline configuration, v2 (2026-10-29; decisions D-104..D-109 and D-112..D-114 of claude/SBI_decisions_and_ideas_log.md, project knowledge; v1 of 14:36 had no sim.plan_args and gp_seed 0, max_concurrent_trials 4). LindDUP (D-104, the user's name): the joint DSN+NPE stack trained on the MEAMA in silico campaign campaign_meama_rho1600_n01 (ANN/Phenomenological/MEAMA) and the DUP15HD recordings (Deep_bio DATA_C control and DATA_P DUP, the cohort of record extracted_v2). Run by configuration (D-105): every value below is LindDUP's; the code is the pipeline's and Sbi-extractor's, with the generic tool changes D-107 (the contact gate stoa_gate_p as a topology axis), D-108 (a campaign without _v<N> has batch 0), D-112 (S2's plan leaves out the tasks still being written, --quiet-hours) and D-113 (every job the pipeline submits starts through its job protocol, jobs/stage_job.sh): the two Sbi-extractor commits of 2026-10-29 on feat/real-arm-parity (the trees are named in the README's LindDUP run sheet: git rev-parse HEAD^{tree}; a commit's hash depends on who applies it). Values not yet read on the data are marked [to verify]: tools/inputs_check.py reads them on davinci before the first submission. Every key is required; a key starting with '_' documents the key after it and is ignored. Where a value is Giulia's (giulia.json v10), it says so.
_paths: Where everything lives on davinci (absolute; no '~'). The two repositories are Giulia's checkouts; every LindDUP folder carries linddup (D-104, as D-046 for Giulia).
_envs: As Giulia's: extraction and banks in sbi_export, training and search in sbi_env.
_real: S1, the real-arm extraction. Done: the DUP15HD cohort of record, extracted_v2/cohort_manifest.json sha256 c925c5106137fe82 (35 wells: control 17 = DATA_C, pathological 18 = DATA_P; 9 subregions of 9 electrodes; 1200 s; HPC_PATHS.md 3b), so the driver skips S1 while the manifest matches its .sha256. cohort_config is the DUP15HD cohort block (read only if S1 ever ran; its launcher refuses a root that already holds a manifest). cohort_tag names LindDUP's own S2 files: sim_reextract/profiles/linddup.sh, its plan folder, the frozen manifest artifacts/cohort_manifest_linddup/ that S4 reads, the jobs ld_*.
_sim: S2, the re-detection of the MEAMA campaign at the DUP15HD probe (n_side 3 and fs 10110.09 from the manifest, pitch 60 um D-021, edge 25 um D-024: the profile). One campaign, one label contract. The campaign is still being written (the user, 2026-10-29 17:37: 'we will run on the available simulations', D-112): plan_args --quiet-hours 6 makes S2's plan leave out every task changed less than 6 h before it (its folder, its topo_* folders, its JSON), named in the plan and the record, and plan again at each round, so a task that has gone quiet joins a later round; a task being written that already has detections is refused (D-060, D-073). inputs_check lists the tasks left out and the pace of the iteration files. Walltimes: Giulia's G2 ran 0.48 s per iteration per worker at one electrode; a 9-electrode probe costs more per iteration [estimate], so 6 h for the test task and for each array task, against MEAMA tasks of 40 topologies per worker [the launcher's default; to verify]; a task killed at its walltime is re-run by the array's RESUME. concurrency 4: what the core cap leaves (D-109: (200 - 4) / 48).
_freeze: S3, the label freeze. The MEAMA campaign is flat with the contact gate swept (D-107): conn_prob and stoa_gate_p are expected in theta. exclude is empty: the finalv1 sweep, which MEAMA's descends from, writes only the causally live connectivity keys (conn_record_keys), so the Weibull axes should be ABSENT, and an exclusion of an axis absent from the data is refused by the freeze [to verify: inputs_check lists the iteration files' keys; if they hold p0_conn, d0_conn, beta_conn as NaN, as the hhgap files did, they must be excluded here as in giulia.json].
_bank: S4-S6, the bank plan and the two banks (export_windows/, written into a profile by stages/bank.py). on_declared_box: the MEAMA registry's O_N box [0.03, 3.0] (ANN smoke_test_stoa_gate.py T1) [to verify on the manifests]; with one campaign the declared box is the sampled one, so the prior is exact (D-078's rule). topology_axes and expected_p: D-107, p = 32 active axes of the tripartite sweep group + conn_prob + stoa_gate_p = 34 [to verify: the manifests' active_indices]. t_win_s: one window per simulation, the whole of it (D-041's rule), so the campaign's simtime: 200 s, the MEAMA launcher's default [to verify]; W = 20,000 at Delta_t 0.01 s. n_e 9: the DUP15HD probe, which the bank checks against the manifest's electrodes_per_subset. floor_hz 0.1 (Giulia's, D-075): at 9 electrodes over 200 s a window needs at least 180 detections (Sbi-extractor SPEC sec. 2.5). Seeds: Giulia's rule, the date. Everything else Giulia's.

bank._verify: Giulia's (D-094): the verification job after every round's gate, 8 cores, 16gb, 2 h.
bank._max_rerun_rounds: Giulia's (D-094/D-095): a bad or missing task is moved to <banks_root>/linddup_sim_quarantine/ (never deleted) and the array runs again, at most twice.

_split: Giulia's (D-088): train / selection / report = 85 / 10 / 5 % of the donors (one donor = one network, D-076; with one simulation per topology every simulation is its own donor).
_search: S7, the GP search, S-A1 (D-106). Giulia's design (D-088, D-086): 50 initial points, then 20 GP rounds of 10 trials, 250 in all; at 4 trials at once under the 200-core cap (D-109) round 0 runs in 13 waves and each GP round in 3, and the 400 h clock (D-090's value) may end the search before round 20 -- an open call (the log's Open calls), to settle once the budget gate has measured a trial.

search._campaign: S-A1, arm A1 (D-106): encoder and flow fitted on the MEAMA windows only; the DATA_C / DATA_P windows enter the runner's post-training diagnostics and, later, the posteriors (D-083).
search._shape_anchors: p and d_theta: the bank's theta width, 34 (D-107) [to verify with the bank]; the search stage refuses a bank of another width. embedding_dim 64 anchors the flow-width rule as for Giulia: s = max(p, embedding_dim) = 64 gives hidden_features in [64, 512].
search._space_overrides: Giulia's (giulia.json v10, F-s, D-086): depth_exponent [3, 5], embedding_size [16, 64] (a summary of at least 16 numbers for 34 parameters), head_pool_ops [0, 1].
search._max_concurrent_trials: Giulia's 25 (D-114: the optimisation and training values are Giulia's); the 200-core cap (D-109) holds 4 trials of 48 at once beside the sequencer's 4, so 4 run at once.
search._seeds: Giulia's (D-114): gp_seed 1 (Giulia's restart value, D-101; v1 had 0); train_seed 0: one donor split for the whole search.
search._gp_noise_sigma: Estimated from the data (the code's default).
search._trial: Giulia's (D-088): 6 passes in 20 epochs, a whole 48-core node, 160gb, 120 h, queue cpu. A LindDUP window is 20,000 samples against Giulia's 18,000, so a trial costs about 11 % more per row [estimate]; the budget gate measures it before round 0.
search._budget_gate: Giulia's: the costliest configuration probed before round 0; the driver stops unless it fits the trial's walltime and memory with a 1.5 safety factor.
search._max_total_walltime_h: 400 h, Giulia's value (D-090); for LindDUP an open call (D-109's Implies): keep, a smaller design, or a longer clock.

_best_fit: S8, Giulia's (D-089): the finalist fitted as an ensemble of 10 members on one shared split (seed 1), 40 passes in 40 epochs, patience 10; at 4 members at once under the cap (D-109).
_loader: Giulia's (D-084): a buffer of 4 shards (10,000 rows each, about 0.8 GB of LindDUP windows per shard).
_driver: Giulia's (D-098): the sequencer as a chain of PBS jobs pl_linddup, 4 cores, 16gb, 24 h each.
_resources: D-109 (the user, 2026-10-29): LindDUP's jobs, the sequencer's included, never ask for more than 200 cores at once: 4 trials, members or re-detection tasks of 48 beside the sequencer's 4. Giulia's cap (400, D-101) is separate: each pipeline counts only its own jobs. To raise it: change the value here, then --stop and submit again with --accept-config-change.
